messages:
marie (People Ops): Quick heads-up — were kicking off a mandatory Privacy & Data Handling refresher + team attestation window. Due in 2 weeks: Fri May 9 2025 23:59 PT. Everyone must finish the SecureLearn 'Privacy 2025' module and managers must upload a short evidence pack for their team. Links below and details on what to include. :calendar:

marie (People Ops): Training: https://securelearn.example.com/courses/privacy-2025 (SSO)
Attestation form: https://forms.example.com/redwood/privacy-attestation-2025
Evidence upload (private Drive): https://drive.example.com/redwood/compliance/2025-privacy-evidence
Naming convention for uploads: `teamname_evidence_YYYYMMDD.zip` — include a README.txt listing files.

marie (People Ops): What we need per team (short):
- Engineering: architecture/dataflow diagram, retention config snippets, runbook references for data exports/backups, one example query with access control notes.
- Platform/SRE: logs retention policy, S3 lifecycle/rm config, sample audit logs (redacted), incident playbooks referencing PII handling.
- Sales/CS: redacted contract example, DPA checklist signed, opt-out/consent templates.
- Product/Design: UI copy for consent, data minimization notes, any tracking tags.

sahil (InfoSec): Clarifier — for audit logs redact user identifiers but keep timestamps and action codes. If youre unsure how to redact, see our redaction playbook: https://confluence.example.com/display/SEC/Redaction+Playbook

jordan (Eng Manager): If someone is on parental leave/LOA during the window, do they still need to complete training?

marie (People Ops): People on approved leave can complete training within 30 days of return. Managers: mark them in the attestation form under the "exceptions" section with expected return date.

alexa (Platform Eng): For engineering evidence, do we need full runbooks or just the sections that touch PII? We have a queued infra migration and dont want to hold it up.

marie (People Ops): Include specific sections that touch PII + a short note in README about any pending changes and expected completion date. If a runbook is internal-only, a pointer + excerpt is fine.

tom (Legal): For redacted contracts — use the standard contract-redaction template from Legal (linked in the attestation form). If you need help redacting at scale, contact Legal and well assist.

ciso (Security Lead): This refresh ties to our ISO readiness run in Q3 and SOC2 maintenance. Non-compliance will trigger manager escalation and may temporarily restrict access to sensitive datasets until resolved. Not punitive for genuine exceptions, but we need coverage for the audit.

jordan (Eng Manager): Can we get a headcount export or list of who on my team still needs training?

devops-bot: Reminder scheduled — automated follow-up will post in #people-ops in 7 days and on the final day.

marie (People Ops): Managers — submit the attestation form by the deadline and upload the evidence bundle to the Drive link. Ill compile a tracker and ping teams with missing items after the deadline. If you want People Ops to run a quick 15-min walkthrough for your team, DM me and Ill schedule.

alexa (Platform Eng): Acknowledged — will consolidate runbook excerpts and upload by next Wed.

sahil (InfoSec): If youre collecting screenshots of admin consoles, mask account emails before upload. Use `mask-email.sh` from the sec-tools repo if needed.

marie (People Ops): Thanks all. If you hit any blocker, @marie (People Ops) or @sahil (InfoSec) are the primary contacts. Please also cc your manager in the attestation form so they can approve. :thumbsup:
